rigid_body_mass_com_inertia.reason: V6 Body frames page provides coordinate-frame drawings, no numeric mass/COM/inertia tables. Official kinematics page displays NAO (V60) as code without a download href; no retrievable official V6 URDF was obtained.
rigid_body_mass_com_inertia.do_not_substitute: V5/V4/old NAO generic URDF values are not verified V6 values.

field_of_view_deg.qualification: Full angles for each camera, not robot 360-degree visibility or a range specification; crop/output-mode/calibration effects require verification.

pose.qualification: Diagram axes/reference poses are not sufficiently specified and angular labels conflict with V6 table; labels retained as diagram readings only, not accepted camera extrinsics.

cameras.framerate_conditions: Manufacturer values depend on network, selected resolution and CPU use, measured with CPU fully dedicated to image gathering. None denotes a dash/not supported in that table, not zero FPS.
cameras.hardware_internal_framerate_note_2_8: OV5640 internally runs at 15 or 30fps; 2560x1920 at 15fps only. Lower API requested FPS does not imply sensor internal FPS changes.

motor_table_as_published.qualification: Rotor no-load speed and motor-shaft torque before gear transmission; not robot walking speed or guaranteed joint torque. Gear efficiency, joint load and thermal limits are not given here.

conflicts_and_implementation_gates.issue: V6 2.8 camera intro says 2560x1920 1fps, same page supported-format table says API 1–15fps, hardware note 15fps; 2026 datasheet advertises top 15fps.
conflicts_and_implementation_gates.action: Keep versioned values; benchmark selected resolution/CPU/network pipeline before choosing control update rate.

conflicts_and_implementation_gates.issue: 2026 datasheet camera drawings show a 60.97-degree horizontal cone and 34.80-degree side cone, differing from V6 text 56.3H/43.7V.
conflicts_and_implementation_gates.action: Do not reconstruct V6 calibrated camera model from these drawings; use text FOV as provisional manufacturer value and calibrate the actual robot.

conflicts_and_implementation_gates.issue: Right ankle simple range and anti-collision knot endpoints differ: simple pitch -67.97..53.40 degrees, knots -68.15..52.87; left endpoints also differ by rounding.
conflicts_and_implementation_gates.action: Preserve both constraints; use their intersection pending actual getLimits/calibration, never expand a static limit to fit a knot.

conflicts_and_implementation_gates.issue: Exact V6 link mass/COM/inertia and formal camera poses were not obtained from verified official sources.
conflicts_and_implementation_gates.action: Full multibody dynamics requires an official as-built model or measured identification; total mass alone is insufficient.

conflicts_and_implementation_gates.issue: Two pelvis joint names share one physical motor.
conflicts_and_implementation_gates.action: Do not model them as independent actuators.

conflicts_and_implementation_gates.issue: The robot outer bounding box and camera focus range are not collision body geometry or target detection range.
conflicts_and_implementation_gates.action: Keep separate parameters; identify foot/limb collision geometry and detection range independently.

issues.summary_zh: KidSize几何、FIFA size1与课程一致；课程每队4台是明确项目设计，规则是最多4台。门宽2.6m一致，无冲突。课程1m缓冲带与规则最小1m不是数值冲突。
课程展示NAO6已有声呐/多麦克风硬件不代表RoboCup允许使用；如严格采用Law4，应屏蔽不合规传感输入。NAO实际双相机是否满足大重叠立体设置需单独核对，不因数量为2就自动合规。
规则pan/tilt上限不同于NAO机械限位；仿真用二者交集，并核对相机安装外参。
180度是所有相机视域并集约束，非单相机实际视场；不能填成NAO HFOV。
课程构建虚拟比赛是开发阶段，不自动等价于官方Virtual Competition。实体专属/虚拟专属条款需由课程采用范围决定。
Laws1-2及全文未找到球质量或摩擦系数数值；Size1本身不足以唯一确定质量。规则也未给球颜色/周长；可继续用课程45cm和黑白或橙色。
AdultSize: p6正文罚球区每侧距柱内侧0.7m，若两柱间2.6m则宽4m；p9表给6m。KidSize对应1.2m与5m一致，不影响本课程KidSize建模。
